description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Name that extends HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform, responsible for transforming HTML attributes by converting 'name' attributes to 'id' attributes when appropriate, ensuring deprecated name attributes are handled correctly.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Name
classes.description: A class that transforms HTML attribute sets by converting 'name' attributes to 'id' attributes if 'id' does not already exist.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attribute array by copying the 'name' attribute to 'id' if 'id' is not already set, essentially replacing deprecated name attributes with id attributes.
